baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired hand objects are restrained only after the clause in which God grants prevalence, and the ayah closes by placing intentional action under divine discernment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same agent grants decisive capacity and arrests its exercise. Hand-as-power, temporal succession, intentional action, and penetrating awareness make the non-use of force an accountable exercise of power rather than evidence that power was absent.

activation_trace.role: Literal withholding and pushing back supplies the brake applied to both directions of attack.
The hand as strength and capacity turns the mirrored limbs into two live powers, not merely two body parts.
Succession after a prior event makes restraint follow empowerment and blocks an inability reading.
Prevailing over an opponent supplies the real dominance whose exercise is then withheld.
Purposive action lets refraining under command count within the field of deliberate deeds.
Penetrating inward knowledge places both visible blows and withheld intentions within divine awareness.

changed_reading.before: God stopped two parties from fighting after one side happened to gain the upper hand.
changed_reading.after: God first makes dominance real and then governs its non-use; restraint after capacity becomes a deliberate deed seen through, not a failure to achieve victory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The syntax mirrors their hands away from you with your hands away from them under one restraining verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: A split hand inventory allows force, aid, and a guarding barrier to coexist. Once each vector is withheld, each side's hand ceases to be only a threat and becomes, by its non-striking, a barrier preserving the body opposite it.

activation_trace.role: Prevention converts active attack vectors into maintained limits.
The alternate hand mapping supplies a guarding barrier, giving positive protective content to non-action.
The helping hand supplies support and prevention of wrong as a live alternative to the weaponized hand.

changed_reading.after: The neutralization is a two-sided shield: each hand, by not striking, protects the person it could have harmed, so restraint itself performs aid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restraining verb, the paired literal hands, the interior of Mecca, and the granted hold over the opponents form one spatial chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Closure, encirclement, bodily interior, and an embedded claw organize the scene as nested containment. The city's inner cavity contains confronting bodies, while the restraining action closes around the very hands that have gained the ability to penetrate.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and closure supplies an enclosing operation rather than only a command to desist.
A group circling an object supplies the perimeter around the face-to-face encounter.
The inside, underside, or cavity makes the city location function as the scene's containing chamber.
Literal hands keep the spatial model attached to bodily contact rather than an abstract enclosure.
A claw lodging in material supplies the unrealized penetration that the enclosure arrests.

changed_reading.before: A ceasefire happens at a geographic place in central Mecca.
changed_reading.after: The city interior acts as a containing chamber: confronting hands are enclosed just when a claw-like hold becomes possible, yielding possession without penetration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restraint follows achieved prevalence, so the focus itself raises the question of how much victory is enough.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant sufficiency mapping and the restraint inventory's no-surplus and equivalence images create a threshold model. Once decisive access has been granted, further hand-action is excess rather than completion; the alternate mapping activates an image without replacing the focus verb's morphology.

activation_trace.role: Carrying an affair until sufficiency supplies the threshold at which further force is no longer needed.
Enough provision without excess supplies a no-surplus measure for the use of victory.
Fit and equivalence supply calibrated proportionality instead of maximal extraction.
Actual prevalence establishes that the stopping point is chosen after success, not imposed by failure.

changed_reading.before: Victory is interrupted before it can be fully cashed out.
changed_reading.after: Victory reaches its proper measure precisely when decisive control is enough and surplus injury is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening names an opening that is itself victory and disclosure. Read back into the focus, the apparent paradox becomes functional: closing the routes of reciprocal violence is one way the promised opening becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Opening as prevalence supplies the context's category for a success that need not be a breached body or city.
Emergence into visibility makes the nonviolent outcome legible as disclosed success rather than concealed failure.
Closure supplies the surprising operation through which the larger opening can be enacted.
Granted prevalence keeps the opening-by-closure model anchored in real victory.

structural_cues: 48:1 intensifies opening through a verb plus cognate noun and marks the result as manifest.
48:24 places restraint after granted prevalence, joining an opening outcome to a closing operation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opening can image prevalence and disclosure, while the focus supplies closure after prevalence. Reader arrow: the closure of violence realizes the opening rather than interrupting it. Live alternative: the opening may denote a separate event whose language only echoes the focus.

changed_reading.before: Opening is the result of victory, while restraint is a later interruption of it.
changed_reading.after: The clear opening can take the form of closure: reciprocal hands are shut down, and that non-breach is itself a disclosed victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated cessation of motion descends into believers, while the later scene opposes heated group pride to descended stillness and protective adherence. The focus's stopped hands become the outward kinematics of governed inner motion; its bilateral surface can coexist with asymmetric interior states.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of movement supplies an inward prototype for the later arrest of hands.
The repeated loss of agitation immediately before a near opening makes stillness productive rather than inert.
Heated pride and anger supply the affective pressure that could otherwise discharge through hands.
Motion dying down counterposes a cooled interior state to heated agitation.
Protection from harm gives the settled state a guarding function rather than mere calmness.
Withholding supplies the bodily endpoint of the context's regulation of motion and heat.
Hand-as-force identifies what outward capacity is prevented from carrying inner agitation into impact.

structural_cues: Stillness descends repeatedly in 48:4, 48:18, and 48:26, and the last occurrence is set against doubled heated pride.
48:24 renders the resulting arrest symmetrically at the level of hands even though 48:26 distinguishes the groups' inner states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recurrent stillness removes motion, heated pride supplies agitation, protection supplies a guarded state, and the focus arrests hand-force. Reader arrow: inward regulation propagates outward into restrained action. Live alternative: the hand-restraint may be wholly external intervention with no psychological causal path.

changed_reading.before: Both sides are symmetrically restrained by an external tactical intervention.
changed_reading.after: The outward symmetry contains an inward asymmetry: heated pride presses toward discharge while descended stillness becomes protective control of hand-power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier vertical arrangement of a divine hand above pledged human hands is rotated into the focus's horizontal reciprocity. A hand placed under higher authority demonstrates the pledge not only by what it does, but by refusing autonomous force when that authority restrains it.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience supplies the prior commitment governing the later use of hand-power.
The yielded hand of obedience and guarantee gives the stacked hands a covenantal function.
The same obedient-hand image makes the believers' restrained hand a performed pledge rather than forced passivity.
Prevention supplies the command boundary within which pledged obedience is tested.
Intentional action allows covenant fidelity to be expressed as chosen non-use of force.

structural_cues: 48:10 stacks one divine hand above plural human hands; 48:24 mirrors two plural hand groups across reciprocal prepositional phrases.
Both scenes place divine agency over the meaning and permitted use of human hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: pledge, yielded hand, and the focus's restrained paired hands are explicit. Reader arrow: the earlier pledge governs the later refusal to strike. Live alternative: the hand imagery may mark protection or power in both places without establishing a covenantal causal link.

changed_reading.before: The believers' hands are restrained in the same tactical way as their opponents' hands.
changed_reading.after: Their restraint also verifies the pledge: the hand under higher authority proves fidelity by declining to act as an autonomous weapon.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier instance of the same restraint-hand formula shields the believers from other people's hands and is called a sign on a guided, straight path. The focus repeats that protection but adds the believers' hands in the opposite direction, turning unilateral safety into a reciprocal limit on the newly protected side.

activation_trace.role: The earlier act of prevention establishes the exact protective operation later expanded in the focus.
Other people's hand-force supplies the one-way threat vector in the first formula.
A visible sign makes restraint evidentiary, something meant to redirect perception and conduct.
Gentle direction toward a way turns the protective event into guidance for later behavior.
The straight road supplies the behavioral course on which restraint is read as guidance.
Straightness and balanced alignment make reciprocity a completion of the earlier one-sided protection.
The repeated prevention now governs both directional clauses.
Paired hand-powers complete the earlier single threat vector as a reciprocal ethical geometry.

structural_cues: 48:20 has one restrained vector, other people's hands away from the believers; 48:24 repeats it and adds the believers' hands away from them.
The earlier formula is followed by sign, guidance, path, and straightness language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an exact one-way restraint formula is followed by guidance language, and the focus expands the formula to two directions. Reader arrow: the second use completes the lesson of the first by limiting the beneficiaries as well as their attackers. Live alternative: the two restraints may be independent protections with no ethical escalation.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a balanced ceasefire in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes an earlier shield: protection becomes straight guidance only when those protected also accept a limit on their own newly available force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding context contrasts human inability with divine encompassing control. The focus then grants human prevalence but encloses its hands inside the city's interior, so capability itself appears as a bounded region within a larger perimeter rather than an autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity to act and possess supplies the contrast between human inability and divinely granted ability.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and control supplies the larger perimeter around human capability.
A containing rim or receptacle supplies a local bound around the hands that could act.
The city interior nests the human encounter inside the larger field of encompassing control.
Real prevalence shows that the inner region contains granted power, not merely powerlessness.

structural_cues: 48:21 places human non-capacity and divine encompassing in one contrast.
48:24 moves from granted prevalence to bounded hands within a named interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: humans cannot reach one object already encompassed by God, while the focus grants and then restrains another capacity. Reader arrow: both inability and ability are variable regions inside one controlling perimeter. Live alternative: the two verses concern separate objects and need not imply a shared spatial model.

changed_reading.before: Human victory is achieved locally and then checked by a separate divine command.
changed_reading.after: Human capacity never exits divine containment: the perimeter can grant access, define its measure, and close the hand without turning victory into defeat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding conditional supplies a decisive battle outcome without requiring that battle to occur: opponents would turn away and find no supporting protector. The focus can therefore name granted prevalence as real control of the outcome while restraint keeps that outcome from being executed through killing.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat supplies the unrealized condition whose result is nevertheless specified.
Protective alliance and aid supply what the predicted losers would fail to find.
Turning the back supplies the predicted retreat that marks decisive asymmetry.
Aid that makes a side prevail supplies the absent reinforcement in the counterfactual outcome.
Granted dominance realizes the asymmetry forecast by the conditional without demanding a body count.
Withholding prevents the known outcome from needing violent demonstration.
The after-clause locates restraint on the far side of established prevalence even if combat remains unrealized.

structural_cues: 48:22 is explicitly conditional and gives a complete result for a fight that is not asserted to occur there.
48:24 says prevalence was granted before both hand-vectors were restrained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the conditional predicts retreat and absence of aid, and the focus states granted prevalence followed by restraint. Reader arrow: secure knowledge and control of the counterfactual outcome can constitute victory without executing it. Live alternative: a limited prior clash may be presupposed, making the prevalence partly actual rather than wholly counterfactual.

changed_reading.before: A realized clash produced victory and was then stopped.
changed_reading.after: The decisive result is made real at the level of control and counterfactual certainty, while restraint prevents victory from needing proof through killing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah supplies an intermingled population whom the acting group cannot identify, the risk of crushing or hitting them, moral contamination without knowledge, mercy, and a conditional separation that has not occurred. Divine sight at the focus's close therefore contrasts with human targeting opacity; restraint is a precision constraint on force inside a mixed interior.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure supplies the discrimination humans lack about concealed people in the target space.
Crushing pressure supplies the indiscriminate bodily harm that unseparated force could cause.
Striking a target supplies the precision problem: an intended hit can land on an unknown protected body.
A stain of harm supplies the moral residue of acting under unresolved identification.
Tender mercy supplies the protective purpose of delaying force rather than merely its tactical inconvenience.
Separation and differentiation supply the absent condition under which selective action would become possible.
A hidden interior turns the city center into an epistemically opaque target space.
Penetrating knowledge supplies the divine discrimination set against human non-knowledge.
Prevention functions as the targeting interlock while identification remains unresolved.
Literal hands keep the epistemic constraint attached to actual bodily force.
Purposive action makes responsibility depend on what actors do under known limits of discrimination.

structural_cues: 48:25 twice foregrounds human non-knowledge and makes harm conditional on an unrecognized mixed population.
The punitive alternative is also conditional on prior separation, while 48:24 closes with unrestricted divine sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: unknown protected people, crushing and target impact, stain without knowledge, mercy, and unrealized separation are explicit. Reader arrow: these details make restraint a discrimination threshold for force. Live alternative: the primary mechanism may be protection of sanctuary and offering, with hidden persons as one additional reason.

changed_reading.before: The reciprocal halt is a general act of mercy or treaty-making.
changed_reading.after: The halt is also a precision rule: inside a mixed and hidden population, force is disabled because human hands cannot distinguish their legitimate target from protected life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of sufficiency with witnessing closes a circuit already latent in the focus's alternate restraint mapping and final divine sight. If the decisive reality is sufficiently witnessed, dominance does not need bodily demonstration; withheld action can carry the proof that violent spectacle would otherwise claim to provide.

activation_trace.role: An affair carried through to sufficiency supplies the claim that no further evidentiary action is needed.
The packet's reverse split mapping links sufficiency back to prevention without collapsing the two lexical forms.
Present witnessing supplies an adequate register of what occurred without public violence as proof.
The focus root's sufficiency target lets prevention be heard as stopping at an adequate measure.
Unobstructed sight supplies the witnessing capacity that makes visible injury unnecessary as evidence.
Intentional deeds include the witnessed choice not to turn prevalence into spectacle.
Actual dominance supplies the fact that requires witness but not violent reenactment.

structural_cues: 48:24 ends with divine sight of action; 48:28 ends with divine sufficiency as witness.
The packet maps the focus restraint root toward sufficiency and the later sufficiency root back toward prevention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: divine sight, sufficient witnessing, granted prevalence, and a bidirectional split mapping between restraint and sufficiency are present. Reader arrow: adequate witness replaces the need to prove victory through injury. Live alternative: both endings may be independent doxological assurances rather than a theory of nonviolent evidence.

changed_reading.before: Divine sight merely records whether the restrained parties obey.
changed_reading.after: Divine sight is itself sufficient witness to the achieved victory, allowing restrained non-action to replace violent demonstration as its proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final plant sequence converts force into a developmental process: a shoot emerges, supports and is supported, thickens, and stands, while the resulting anger remains affect in the observer. This activates the focus's helping-hand branch so that withheld striking power is not idle but redirected into mutual support and durable growth.

activation_trace.role: Cultivated emergence and growth supplies the non-combat domain into which communal power can be redirected.
A shoot emerging beside its root supplies new life that strengthens through relation rather than attack.
Plants stiffening through mutual support supplies the causal conversion from hand-force to collective reinforcement.
Thickening after thinness supplies strength as accumulated growth rather than inflicted damage.
Rising and settling upright supplies the stable result of supported growth.
Anger held in the chest supplies charged opposition that need not be answered by reciprocal impact.
The helping hand supplies the focus anchor for converting hand-power from striking to mutual reinforcement.
Withholding blocks the violent channel so capacity can take the developmental channel instead.
Purposive work keeps the growth model attached to an alternative mode of action rather than mere passivity.

structural_cues: 48:29 gives a strict developmental sequence from shoot to support to thickness to uprightness, followed by the opponents' anger.
48:24 has already separated possession of hand-power from its discharge as reciprocal violence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: plant growth, mutual support, thickening, uprightness, latent anger, helping hands, and withheld force are supplied. Reader arrow: blocked striking capacity is redirected into collective cultivation. Live alternative: the plant similitude may describe communal formation independently of the focus's restrained hands.

changed_reading.before: Restrained hands are temporarily idle weapons.
changed_reading.after: Their strength can be rerouted into supportive work that thickens and steadies a community, while hostile anger is left contained rather than answered hand for hand.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates concrete claw branches inside a verb of prevailing. It remains valid as a material analogy because the same focus places that root beside literal hands and an explicit restraining operation. Downstream prose should mark it as an image of controlled capacity, not as a replacement gloss for victory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prevalence root sits between paired hands and their restraint, allowing the packet's claw and embedding branches to model what those hands are prevented from doing.

activation_trace.role: The claw supplies a bodily implement of dominance contiguous with the focus's literal hands.
A claw sinking into material supplies the unrealized injury-path of achieved dominance.
Withholding arrests the claw before capacity becomes penetration.
Literal hands keep the claw analogy attached to the focus's bodily scene.

changed_reading.before: God enabled victory and then stopped further combat.
changed_reading.after: God grants a claw-like hold yet keeps it from sinking in: the victory is real precisely as controlled, unspent penetration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it links an eye membrane and sight-withholding branches to a victory construction. It remains anchored through the focus's prevalence root, restraining root, literal hand imagery, and final divine sight. Downstream prose should present it as a perceptual warning generated by the branch field, not as philological identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from restraint through prevalence to an all-seeing close, while both the restraint and prevalence inventories contain unusual visual branches.

activation_trace.role: A membrane covering the eye supplies the possibility that triumph itself clouds human perception.
The eye's encounter with what it sees supplies a second visual edge within the prevalence root.
Withheld sight supplies perceptual closure as a danger parallel to withheld hands.
A hand shading the brow in order to discern supplies restraint as a condition for clearer looking.
Unobstructed eyesight supplies the clear divine seeing against which victory-clouded human sight is measured.

changed_reading.before: The closing sight formula only states surveillance of conduct.
changed_reading.after: It also contains a perceptual reversal: prevalence can film over human sight, while restraining the hand creates distance for discernment under unobstructed divine seeing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines bodily-interior, womb, separation, and shoot imagery into a gestational model of the city. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit interior location and restraint, then gains concrete support from the concealed mixed population and later emergence imagery. Downstream prose should call it a cross-domain spatial analogy, not claim that the place-name construction literally means pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The encounter occurs in the city's interior while hands are restrained, and the next ayah reveals concealed lives that have not yet been differentiated from the surrounding population.

activation_trace.role: An inner cavity that can contain a fetus supplies the gestational geometry of the city interior.
Prevention supplies the protective suspension around life hidden in that interior.
Undisclosed knowledge supplies concealed identities not yet available to human discrimination.
The womb branch supplies a contained-life image activated by mercy in the concealed population scene.
Differentiation supplies the not-yet-completed emergence of protected lives from the mixed interior.
A new shoot emerging around its root supplies a later organic image for protected future appearance.

changed_reading.before: The city interior is only the location where mutual violence is halted.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a gestational enclosure: force is suspended around concealed life until differentiation and later emergence can occur.

strongest_changes: The one-way protective restraint of 48:20 becomes reciprocal in 48:24, making guided protection include a limit on the protected side's own force.
The concealed mixed population of 48:25 turns restraint into an epistemic precision rule: no force while protected and target bodies cannot be distinguished.
The heat and repeated stillness sequence culminates in stopped hands, allowing external symmetry and internal asymmetry to coexist.
The sufficient witness of 48:28 changes divine sight from passive surveillance into an alternative to proving victory through bodily harm.
The conditional battle outcome of 48:22 allows prevalence to be real as control without requiring its execution through killing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates a paradox: one divine agency grants prevalence, restrains both sides, locates them inside an interior, and sees their intentional action. Split mappings keep several live mechanisms together, including protection, no-surplus sufficiency, containment, claw control, and perceptual correction, without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrow from descended inner stillness to outwardly stopped hands is abductive; direct external restraint remains live.
The opening-by-closure model may describe the focus itself or only resonate with a distinct opening elsewhere in the surah.
The prevalence may be wholly counterfactual control or may presuppose a limited actual encounter.
The sufficiency, visual, ecological, and gestational activations depend on packet-supported branch crossings and should remain explicitly exploratory where marked.
